title: ChatGPT Google Chrome extension gains tab-viewing features
excerpt: OpenAI has updated its ChatGPT Google Chrome extension to let the AI view your currently open browser tabs.
body_html:
OpenAI has rolled out new capabilities for its Google Chrome extension, allowing ChatGPT to access and view open browser tabs.

While OpenAI's previous ChatGPT Atlas browser has been discontinued, the updated Chrome extension introduces the ability for the AI to interact directly with a user's active browsing session. According to OpenAI, users can utilize this feature by tagging Chrome while using ChatGPT on either the web platform or the desktop application.

The company demonstrated the functionality in a newly released video, showing how the AI can reference and use information from the tabs a user already has open in their browser.
